text: Every AI demo video looks the same. Slides, a robot voice, and music from a toy ad.
So we built demo. A Claude Code skill that makes the whole film.
Give it a brief. It writes the script, voices it in one take, records your real app, and lands every cut on the beat.
Then it checks its own work. Any scene under eight out of ten gets rendered again. Any overlap fails the build.
Two hundred and ten recorded sounds. Free, and on your machine.
This film was made with it. It's on GitHub.
